sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Unlocks video playback and removes ads and forced updates. Requires Android 10 or later.

sources.label: Beyonder Morphe patches
sources.author: Beyonder
patch_list: Lets the seek distance of the player's left/right keys be set inside the app. Applies to the D-pad and to the media rewind/fast-forward keys, and adds "Seek 30s/1m/5m/10m/30m" choices to the SPEED tab of the player settings panel.
Hides the blocking update dialog and the update prompt.
Starts playback at the best available resolution instead of the built-in 480p default. An explicit choice in the settings panel still takes precedence.

Uses the signed DASH streams of the mobile play-info endpoint, so 480p/720p/1080p/4K actually select a real video track instead of reloading the same low-res MP4. Falls back to the TV streams when the mobile ladder is unavailable or lower.
Reports the account as VIP, clears the per-title VIP locks and removes the visitor region block.
